svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "Noto Sans", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.title: App and docs, kept separate
svg.desc: The page shell no longer requests the old builder's script, docs diagrams are regenerated from specs, and the build refuses docs that name the old builder. Login and API behavior are unchanged.
